title: Parichay
desc: Jobless Ravi accepts the daunting task of tutoring five spoiled children who chased away every teacher, but soon wins their trust and falls in love with Rama, the eldest.

desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

desc: Praveen Patel, a 45-year-old businessman, loves his religious wife but feels bored. His life changes when a young actress wants to live with him to prepare for a role.
